scope: Private local research/demo application. Browser and Python evidence only; no guarantee of perfect behavior, profitability, or live-broker readiness.

interpretation.local_and_mocked_verified: Successful local behavior plus connected behavior using the test-only fictional broker.
interpretation.mocked_verified: Successful actual local HTTP/UI behavior against fictional broker responses only.
interpretation.safety_gate_verified_only: Expected protective refusal/disabled state verified; actual authorized strategy promotion not demonstrated.
interpretation.unsupported_disabled: Unavailable feature deliberately disabled; this is a verified lock, not successful execution.
interpretation.external_link_reviewed_not_verified: Destination/HTML attributes reviewed; external service availability/authentication not tested.

coverage_limits: Statement coverage is from unittest only; separately running browser/server child processes were not combined.
Statement coverage is not branch coverage or proof that every function/input/fault path works.
The callable inventory counts top-level functions and class methods; nested functions are not counted.
Connected browser inventory contains aliases for form/submit controls; canonical DOM inventory remains 115 rather than adding alias counts.
The broker fixture does not launch autonomous worker loops. Worker signal/order paths use deterministic Python tests.
A protected disabled state is reported separately from a successful execution.

blocked_or_unrun.check: Authenticated Deriv REST/OTP/WebSocket, genuine quotes, orders and settlement
blocked_or_unrun.reason: No usable broker bindings were available. Current official API HTTPS reachability was denied by cloud proxy HTTP 403; saved allowance is not applied runtime proof.
Package extraction, offline install and launcher startup were verified on Linux. Windows Python launcher is supplied but was not executed on Windows; no standalone .exe is represented as tested.
Disabled in code and UI; real accounts remain read-only.
No MT5 adapter, live margin/lot/tick/stop/fill model.
User-supplied calendar coverage/freshness/blackout guards are tested; there is no automatic licensed feed.

blocked_or_unrun.check: Profitability, calibrated forecasting, production security certification
blocked_or_unrun.reason: Software tests and simulated records do not establish financial performance or production readiness.

package_checks.offline_dependency: websocket-client 1.9.2 universal wheel verified against requirements.lock SHA-256
package_checks.extracted_package: Fresh extraction, private virtual environment, offline hash-verified install and Linux launcher HTTP readiness passed
